description:
A warehouse facility will lose heating during a storm where temperatures will drop to -15 °C. You must determine which stored chemicals are at risk of solidifying (freezing) and bursting their containers. 

Using CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), look up the Melting/Freezing Point for these five chemicals: 
1. Acetic acid, glacial
2. Acetone
3. Nitrobenzene
4. Toluene
5. Phenol

Create a report file at '~/Documents/freezing_risk_report.txt'. For each chemical, list its melting point and state YES or NO if it will solidify at -15 °C (it solidifies if its melting point is HIGHER than -15 °C).

The report MUST follow this exact format:

CHEMICAL: Acetic acid, glacial | MELTING_POINT_C: <value> | SOLIDIFIES_AT_MINUS15: <YES/NO>
CHEMICAL: Acetone | MELTING_POINT_C: <value> | SOLIDIFIES_AT_MINUS15: <YES/NO>
CHEMICAL: Nitrobenzene | MELTING_POINT_C: <value> | SOLIDIFIES_AT_MINUS15: <YES/NO>
CHEMICAL: Toluene | MELTING_POINT_C: <value> | SOLIDIFIES_AT_MINUS15: <YES/NO>
CHEMICAL: Phenol | MELTING_POINT_C: <value> | SOLIDIFIES_AT_MINUS15: <YES/NO>
TOTAL_AT_RISK: <number>
PRIORITY_MOVE_LIST: <comma-separated names of chemicals that solidify>
